title: HyperHarness: Learning to Generate Personalized Agent Harnesses from User Histories
title_zh: HyperHarness：学习从用户历史生成个性化智能体运行框架
abstract_en: Personalized LLM agents rely on an agent harness, the surrounding memory and control code, to connect user history with downstream decisions. Existing methods typically employ either a single shared memory workflow across all users, which is efficient to deploy but cannot adapt how evidence is retrieved and interpreted across diverse histories, or per-user harness optimization, which customizes behavior for each user but requires costly repeated candidate evaluation at deployment and suffers from sparse, noisy supervision in raw logs. To address this trade-off, we present HyperHarness, a framework that learns a shared history-to-harness generator to synthesize executable, user-specific retrieval and answer-guidance code directly from user histories. Given a user's permitted history, HyperHarness prompts a construction LLM to write personalized retrieval and guidance functions, while downstream task scores across training users supervise iterative refinements to the shared generator without reference harnesses or answering-model updates. At deployment, the frozen generator constructs a harness for each unseen user in a single pass from history alone, eliminating per-user task-scored search. Across three benchmarks (PersonaMemv3, Mem-PAL, and MemoryCD) and three answering models (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B, and GPT-5.6-Luna), HyperHarness achieves the highest aggregate score in seven of nine settings and ranks second in the remaining two, improving over the strongest baselines by up to 5.95 points while cutting matched answer-time tokens by 90.32% over long-context prompting. Analyses show that optimization tailors context allocation to each executor, transfers to unseen user clusters, and amortizes adaptation costs.
abstract_zh: 个性化大语言模型（LLM）智能体依靠运行框架（agent harness）中的记忆与控制代码，将用户历史与下游决策关联起来。现有方法要么为所有用户采用同一套记忆流程，部署高效，却难以根据不同用户的历史调整证据检索与解读方式；要么逐用户优化运行框架，虽然更灵活，却需要在部署时反复评估候选方案，且原始日志提供的监督稀疏、噪声较大。HyperHarness 学习一个共享生成器，由构建用 LLM 根据获准使用的用户历史生成可执行的个性化检索与作答引导函数。训练时，系统利用训练用户的下游任务得分迭代改进生成器，无需参考运行框架，也不更新作答模型。部署时，冻结的生成器仅凭新用户的历史即可一次生成其专属框架，无需逐用户搜索和评分。在 PersonaMemv3、Mem-PAL、MemoryCD 三个基准与 Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B、GPT-5.6-Luna 三个作答模型组成的九种设置中，HyperHarness 七项综合得分第一、两项第二，较最强基线最高提升 5.95 分；相比长上下文提示，在匹配条件下，作答阶段的 token 用量减少 90.32%。分析表明，该方法能针对不同执行模型调整上下文分配，并迁移到训练中未见的用户群体。
key_points_zh: 个性化发生在代码层：共享生成器为不同用户编写可执行的检索与作答引导函数，而非让所有用户共用一套记忆流程。
训练以跨用户的下游任务得分为监督，无需参考运行框架或更新作答模型；部署时则用冻结生成器一次完成适配。
在三个基准与三个作答模型的九种组合中，七项综合得分第一、两项第二，较最强基线最高提升 5.95 分。
相较长上下文提示，在匹配条件下作答阶段的 token 用量减少 90.32%；分析还显示，该方法可按执行模型调整上下文分配，并泛化到未见用户群体。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 用训练用户的下游任务得分迭代改进可复用的 harness 生成器，使其部署时能为新用户一次生成个性化代码，无需逐用户评分搜索。九组基准与模型组合中有七组总分第一；摘要未说明生成器的具体更新规则。
